description: Vietnam veteran with 161 Recce Flight; ADF-Serials: now on display at the Army Museum Bandiana.

Caribou fuselage displayed at the museum. ADF-Serials suggests A4-134 (transferred to Army at Puckapunyal in 1964, believed at Bandiana but not sighted recently); aviationmuseum.eu identifies it as A4-264, which ADF-Serials places in outside storage after Caribou retirement. Identity unresolved so the serial is left blank.
